form.div:
Best use: Prepare a context-aware customer follow-up for the selected channel.
Features: Purpose, tone, recent timeline, optional service context, editable draft, and channel handoff.
Priority: Verify the recipient, facts, promises, and tone before opening the channel. The generated text is a draft and is never sent automatically.

button.name: action_generate
button.help: Draft a message using the selected channel, tone, purpose, recent customer timeline, and optional catalog service. Review and edit the draft before opening the channel.

field.name: draft
field.placeholder: The AI draft appears here — edit freely before sending…

button.name: action_send
button.help: Open the selected communication channel with this reviewed draft. Confirm the recipient and content in the channel before final sending.
Close without opening a channel. The draft is not sent to the customer.
